_comment: End-to-end pixel-perfect physics parity test, modeled on dont-move-jv.json through the complete shared preloader -> intro -> login -> Search -> Level ID 6520046 -> pixel-perfect -> Play flow. Immediately after Play, hold Up+Right continuously and pulse Space every 0.2 seconds across level loading, countdown, and the opening gameplay window. Putting input directly after Play keeps physics frame zero aligned even though Flash uses timed coordinate fallbacks and OpenFL resolves live display objects. The saveConsoleTrace action enables the Flash physics-trace.flag for the whole sequence and physicsTrace=1 for OpenFL, then writes the target log near the end of the run.

steps._note: skip Jiggmin intro anim if present (harmless empty click otherwise)
repeat Log In after a slow Jiggmin skip; harmless on the already-open login form
'-' delete saved user (drops a remembered session so both clients show the name/pass form); no-op on the fresh form
confirm OK on the delete-account dialog; harmless stray click on empty dialog area when no confirm appeared
choose Level ID, the third selector option

steps.name: play_bt
steps._note: Play button is lower because the Search form shifts its result grid down
ordered immediately after Play; hold jump through loading, countdown, and race
ordered immediately after Play; hold right through loading, countdown, and race
render time fluctuates, so pulse item input across loading plus the first ten seconds of gameplay; refresh held keys so listeners created during loading observe them
